==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I see chocolate milkshakes and roller skaters everywhere. There are crazy ramps and graffiti all around. I am trying to get to class.

I arrive at a game development class. We study RPGs and card games. My professor doesn't like that my textbook is digital, and she reveals herself to be a zombie queen.

I go out into the courtyard. The professor sends zombie dogs to try and attack me, but the zombies are hurt by sunlight. I fight until my alarm wakes me up.
